scope: Audit the completed acquisition layer, mechanics/restriction field coverage, and bidirectional PQ↔skill parity after batch 545.

pq_skill_parity.rule: Every canonical skill carrying source_parallel_quests/source_quest is represented by a pq_rewards_skill relationship, and every canonical pq_rewards_skill target resolves to a canonical skill name.

restriction_review.boundary: Null race_restriction is an enrichment gap, not evidence of a hidden race restriction. usable_by_cac is not converted into a race restriction without direct identity/restriction evidence.

mechanics_boundary.interpretation: The canonical schema currently stores bounded mechanics in mechanics_notes and does not require separate version-history fields. Version/patch provenance remains a future enrichment layer.

evidence_boundary: No race restriction, patch history, exact frames, damage scaling, reward probability, hidden condition, or variant identity is inferred from null fields or from usable_by_cac alone. Canonical skills.json remains authoritative.
